columns.name: item_salepricechangemargin

columns.validationmsg: "Please enter valid upper sale qty limit"
columns.name: item_uppersaleqtylimit

table.retrieve:
SELECT		item.name ,
				item.saleprice ,
				item.icode,
				item.Packcode, 
				item.SalePrice,
				item.PurPrice, 
				item.SaleDiscPerc, 
				item.PurDiscPerc, 
				item.ReorderQty, 
				item.OptimumQty, 
				item.PackUnits, 
				item.Active ,
				item.Prescribed ,
				item.icatcode,
				item.Refrigrated ,
				item.saleprice2,
				item.saleprice3,
				item.Printable ,
				item.iccode,
				item.packSalestax,
				item.GSTPerc1,
				item.GSTPerc2,
				item.printexpiry,
				item.packcode,
				item.usercode,
				item.lastupdate,
				item.packingcost,
				item.itemalertcode,
				Item.AlternatePurPrice,
				Item.MinSalePrice,
				Item.SalePriceChangeMargin,
				Item.UpperSaleQtyLimit,
				Item.SalesTaxScheduleCode,
				item.PCTCode

  FROM item ,
       manufacturer     
 WHERE ( manufacturer.manfcode = item.manfcode ) and          
		 ( item.manfcode = :ar_manfcode ) AND item.Active=1
